text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! And that's how I run!<n>Doesn't it just
make your heart<n>race? I'm going to keep this up
and<n>defeat Taiki with this speed of mine!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! Taiki's not going to<n>make her debut
anytime soon? What<n>am I supposed to do with this
burning<n>passion now?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
On the bright side, my junior year is<n>now mine for
the taking! First up is<n>the Daily Hai Junior Stakes!
Keep<n>your eyes on me, everyone!
